summary: Iteration 19: Tested 'Create Invoice from Note' + 'Send Forms via SMS (Twilio unconfigured)'. Backend: 15/15 pytest passing. Frontend: biller Create-from-Note flow (modal open, patient select, notes list, prefill, add CPT, save) verified; saved invoice count 76→77. Forms SMS button renders alongside WhatsApp/copy-link; clicking it (Twilio env empty) shows info toast 'SMS is not configured yet. Add Twilio credentials to enable text sending.' — degrades gracefully. Empty-state message 'No progress notes found for this patient.' verified. Regression: manual invoice create, forms list, claim-packets GET all OK.
critical_code_review_comments: sms_configured() reads env at call-time (good). send_sms swallows twilio exceptions and returns False (good); consider returning error reason for observability.
notes_for_billing does not enforce patient existence — returns [] for unknown patient_id. Acceptable but a 404 would be more explicit.
In forms.py send-sms, when patient has no phone but Twilio configured, 400 fires; keep in mind order of checks is correct (public_token → configured → phone).

Frontend Invoices.js applyNote() closes modal and shows success toast — works. Minor: only 'reason_for_visit' is injected into reasonOptions if not in fixed list; other free-text notes may not be preserved if user re-selects a fixed option.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test invoice via biller UI (label starts with MB- auto-number). Backend regression test also created 1 invoice with 'TEST-' prefix. Cannot delete (no delete endpoint for invoices).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Twilio env is intentionally empty — send-sms returns {sent:false, configured:false} and this is expected. FORMS_ROLES excludes admin so admin gets 403 on send-sms (verified — test kept permissive to log). Backend test file: test_iter19_notes_billing_sms.py — 15 tests covering role matrix, empty patient, non-existent form, unauth, plus regression checks.
